features: Full-Size Foldable Bluetooth Keyboard: This Nilkin pocket-sized foldable keyboard weighs only 8 oz, with a compact folded dimension of 7.1 x 4.2 in, making it easy to carry around or store in a briefcase without taking up much space. It offers maximum convenience with minimal weight and size!

Remote Work Assistant: Featuring a standard layout with full-size 0.63-inch keys designed to match finger dimensions and typing habits, it ensures instant and smooth typing experience. The silent scissor-switch mechanism allows complete focus on work. Includes a charging cable and velvet storage pouch—making it the perfect companion for remote work and business travel. More than just a keyboard, it's your ultimate travel solution.

Number Pad with Touchpad Combo: The Nilkin Wireless Keyboard combines a number pad and touchpad in one compact design, allowing seamless mode switching via shortcut keys. The multi-touch pad supports essential gestures like scrolling and clicking, enabling device control without a mouse. The number pad significantly boosts efficiency when working with Excel sheets, entering passwords, or replying to emails. Ditch the bulky mouse and work efficiently anywhere.

Multi-Device Connectivity: The Nilkin Bluetooth keyboard connects to 3 devices simultaneously for seamless switching. Connection steps: turn on keyboard, press FN+BT 1/2/3 (light blinks), then FN+C, and enable Bluetooth on your device. Compatible with Windows, Mac OS, iOS, and Android - type across your iPad, phone, or laptop and switch instantly while working.

Elegant Cube Pocket Keyboard: Crafted from ABS and PU leather with non-slip silicone pads, this portable foldable keyboard remains lightweight and stable while resisting daily wear and dirt. Complete with a charging cable and velvet pouch, it makes a perfect gift for writers, students, IT professionals, remote workers, and family members.
for iPhone Touchpad use Enable Assistive Touch: Settings > Accessibility > Touch > Assistive Touch
